children: According to ChainCatcher citing SoSoValue, U.S. spot ZEC ETFs recorded total net inflows of $1.77 million on Nov. 6 (U.S. Eastern Time). Zcash ETF (ZCSH) was the only fund to post inflows that day, bringing its cumulative net inflows to $209 million. As of publication, the ETFs had $772 million in total net assets, with a ZEC net asset ratio of 3.40% and cumulative historical net inflows of $209 million.

title: U.S. ZEC Spot ETFs Record $1.77 Million in Daily Net Inflows
